svg.aria-label: EDGE: Traefik v3 with a rate limit, a 1 MiB body limit and the Coraza WAF with OWASP CRS v4. BUS AND DATABASE: NATS JetStream and PostgreSQL 18 on an internal network. No host ports. TELEMETRY: grafana/otel-lgtm takes OTLP on 4317 and 4318. Grafana on localhost:3000
